He also discusses investments in sports teams and predicts at least a dozen trillion-dollar companies will come out of the AI cycle. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Observing Distortions in the AI Market: Sixth Street's Alan Waxman
items.excerpt: On "Bloomberg Deals", Sixth Street co-founder, CEO and co-CIO Alan Waxman talks with Dani Burger. They discuss the AI investment cycle, credit markets and sports investments. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Cinco gráficos que muestran la enorme relevancia de Nvidia
items.excerpt: Nvidia llegó a acercarse a una valoración de US$6 billones. Ahora, el escándalo de Jensen Huang ha golpeado sus acciones y expuesto un problema que inquieta a los inversionistas: no hay un sucesor claro.

items.headline: Nvidia's Future Rests Squarely on Shoulders of CEO Huang
items.excerpt: Nvidia Corp.’s investigation of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy is raising questions about the company’s future and sending its stock into a tailspin. If he leaves, can the company survive? That's a question many on Wall Street are trying to answer.

items.headline: UK’s Healey Promises to Avoid US-Style Data Center Free-for-All
items.excerpt: The UK will not allow the sort of “free-for-all” on data center development that’s sparked a public and political backlash in the US, threatening to stall investment in artificial intelligence, Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey said.

items.headline: Applied Intuition In Talks to Raise $1.5 Billion at $30 Billion Value
items.excerpt: Applied Intuition Inc., a defense contractor developing technology for autonomous vehicles, is in talks to raise at least $1.5 billion in a new funding round led by General Catalyst, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Meta’s Head of Infrastructure, Engineering to Depart in 2027
items.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc.’s longtime infrastructure chief will leave the company in early 2027, a major leadership change as it continues to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in artificial intelligence and the data centers needed to support it.

items.headline: CoreWeave Shares Soar After AI Computing Firm Eases Debt Fears
items.excerpt: CoreWeave Inc. shares soared after the AI computing supplier eased fears about its debt-laden business and signaled that sales growth remains strong despite the many headwinds facing the data center boom.

items.headline: Nvidia Is Playing Out Like a Greek Tragedy, Says Seaport's Goldberg
items.excerpt: Jay Goldberg, Seaport senior analyst, says Nvidia would lose its identity without CEO Jensen Huang. Goldberg says the risk of Huang being removed is significant. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Helsing Unveils AI Military Software to Challenge Palantir
items.excerpt: Helsing Gmbh, a German dronemaker, released a platform that uses artificial intelligence to help military units process data from the field more quickly, creating a new European challenger to US-based Palantir Technologies Inc.

items.headline: Nvidia Gets Rare Downgrade as Baird Raises CEO Uncertainities
items.excerpt: Wall Street sentiment toward Nvidia Corp. is starting to crack, as an investigation into Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy is sowing doubt over the artificial intelligence chipmaker’s prospects.
